items.title: 18.10.2 Manganate(VII) ion ka iron(II) ion se reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the manganate(VII)-iron(II) reaction (PDF 34).

blocks.text: Is reaction mein MnO4- reduce aur Fe2+ oxidise hota hai. Reduction ki shakal mein half-reactions yeh hain:

MnO4- ka E zyada musbat hai, is liye woh reduce aur Fe2+ oxidise hota hai. Paanch Fe2+ ions woh paanch electrons dete hain jo aik MnO4- ion ko chahiye: MnO4- + 8H+ + 5Fe2+ -> Mn2+ + 5Fe3+ + 4H2O. E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation) = 1.52 - 0.77 = +0.75 V. Musbat qeemat batati hai ke reaction mumkin hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Fe3+/Fe2+ ka E -0.77 V chhaapti, dono qeematein jor kar E cell = +2.29 V nikalti, aur kul mua'adla MnO4- + 5Fe2+ -> Mn2+ + 5Fe2+ + 4H2O likhti hai. Is ka apna Quick Check 18.8 +0.77 V deta hai. Sabaq +0.77 V, E cell = +0.75 V, aur 8H+ aur 5Fe3+ wala balanced mua'adla use karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik mole MnO4- ke saath kitne mole Fe2+ react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Paanch: har MnO4- paanch electrons leta aur har Fe2+ aik deta hai.
